profile.name: Md. Hasanuzzaman
profile.title: Head of the Department
profile.heroDesc: Head of the Department of **Computer Science & Engineering** at the **Canadian University of Bangladesh**. Educator and researcher securing the networks that connect our world — from protocols and infrastructure to the data flowing through them.
about: **Md. Hasanuzzaman** serves as the **Head of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)** at the Canadian University of Bangladesh (CUB), where he leads academic programs, curriculum development and faculty initiatives that prepare students for the rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Educated in both Bangladesh and Canada, he earned his **B.Sc. from Khulna University** and his **M.Sc. in Information Technology from the University of Waterloo, Canada**. He is currently pursuing his **Ph.D.**, deepening his work at the intersection of networking and security.

His research focuses on **Computer Networking, Cyber Security, Network Security and Data Security**, with published work spanning mobile IoT architectures for smart cities and intelligent energy systems.
profile.office: Dept. of CSE, Canadian University of Bangladesh, Dhaka

research.title: Computer Networking
research.desc: Network architecture, protocols, routing and performance — designing reliable, scalable infrastructure including mobile IoT and smart-city systems.

research.title: Cyber Security
research.desc: Threat analysis, vulnerability assessment and defensive strategies that protect systems, organisations and people against evolving cyber attacks.

research.title: Network Security
research.desc: Intrusion detection, firewalls, secure communication and traffic analysis to safeguard data in transit across complex network environments.

research.title: Data Security
research.desc: Cryptography, access control and privacy-preserving techniques ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of critical data.

education.desc: Advancing research in computer networking and security.
Graduate studies at one of Canada's leading institutions for computing and technology.
Undergraduate foundation in computing and engineering principles.

leadership.intro: As Head of the Department at the Canadian University of Bangladesh, he guides the department's academic vision — shaping an industry-relevant curriculum, mentoring faculty and students, and fostering a culture of research and innovation in computing.
